Spectral19.rankOne_diagonal_bound.{u_1, u_2} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  {ι : Type u_2} (b : ι → H) (hb : Orthonormal ℂ b) (u v : H) :
  (Summable fun i => ‖⟪u, b i⟫_ℂ * ⟪b i, v⟫_ℂ‖) ∧ ∑' (i : ι), ‖⟪u, b i⟫_ℂ * ⟪b i, v⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖
'Spectral19.rankOne_diagonal_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Spectral19.nuclear_diagonal_interchange.{u_1, u_2} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  {ι : Type u_2} (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H) (u v : ℕ → H) (hc : Summable fun n => ‖u n‖ * ‖v n‖) :
  (Summable fun p => ‖⟪u p.1, b p.2⟫_ℂ * ⟪b p.2, v p.1⟫_ℂ‖) ∧
    ∑' (i : ι) (n : ℕ), ⟪u n, b i⟫_ℂ * ⟪b i, v n⟫_ℂ = ∑' (n : ℕ), ⟪u n, v n⟫_ℂ
'Spectral19.nuclear_diagonal_interchange' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Spectral19.nuclear_operator_diagonal.{u_1, u_2} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  {ι : Type u_2} (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (u v : ℕ → H) (hc : Summable fun n => ‖u n‖ * ‖v n‖)
  (hT : ∀ (x : H), HasSum (fun n => ⟪u n, x⟫_ℂ • v n) (T x)) : ∑' (i : ι), ⟪b i, T (b i)⟫_ℂ = ∑' (n : ℕ), ⟪u n, v n⟫_ℂ
'Spectral19.nuclear_operator_diagonal' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
